blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bukidnon Rep. Jonathan Keith Flores serves as one of the House panel prosecutors in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. Born April 16, 1972, Flores notably serves as the lead prosecutor of the panel on Article III, or Duterte’s alleged bribery of Department of Education (DepEd) officials. READ: Highlights: Day 31 of Sara Duterte impeachment trial However, his first foray leading the prosecution’s direct examination was on Thursday, Oct. 1 as Davao City Register of Deeds Atty.
